panels.description: Alex’s scarred fingers pull the worn blue book from the top shelf. It tips like a lever and stops. Dust puffs from the shelf edge. Keep the book and mechanism clear. Place CLICK beside Alex’s fingers and RUMBLE beside the shifting shelf, at distinct heights.

The bookshelf swings outward like a door, revealing a black rectangle. Warm apartment light spills across the dusty floor into cold darkness. Alex steps back; Grandmother remains calm in her chair. Reserve the upper-right for Alex’s balloon.
Grandmother sits calmly and faintly smiles as Alex turns from the opening toward her. Keep the open bookshelf visible and reserve the upper third for dialogue.
Alex’s heavy scuffed boot crosses from warm apartment light into cold workshop darkness. Grandmother and the open bookshelf remain visible. No lettering over the boot or threshold.

items.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
items.text: He said you'd be ready at eighteen.
